name: Vericto Account MCP
description: Database guardrails for AI agents. Hosted Vericto account MCP server at https://mcp.vericto.com/mcp/account, connected over OAuth 2.1 and acting for the person who connected it, within the scopes they granted. Reads workspace setup, rules, configuration, reports and docs. check_sql spends the workspace's monthly check allowance and stores a report, open_support_ticket writes a ticket, and apply_config_change applies a change the person reviewed, which can only add protection. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Grant only the OAuth scopes the task needs; a tool missing a scope names it, and the person adds it in Dashboard > MCP connections.
Review the diff from plan_config_change before approving apply_config_change; each planned change is single-use, expires after a few minutes, and changes that lower protection stay in the dashboard.
Show the final ticket text to the person before approving open_support_ticket.
Do not re-run check_sql on unchanged SQL while the ruleset_version reported by whoami is unchanged; each check spends allowance and stores a report.
